_doc: PENDING S5 payload-semantic conformance vectors — NOT YET WIRED. These describe the PER-OPCODE PAYLOAD + FS-SEMANTIC obligations the S5 stories (F-08 filesystem read: FILE_LIST/FILE_STAT/FILE_GET_*; F-09 filesystem write: windowed FILE_PUT + DELETE/MKDIR/RENAME; F-17 workspace-jail enforcement) will pin in the SHARED cross-language corpus (corpus.json), byte-identical for the firmware pble_* codec and the Dart pble client. They carry NO frame_hex ON PURPOSE: the byte encodings + transfer semantics they depend on live in protocol.md §5 (File transfer), which is STILL DRAFT — §5 has NO 'FROZEN for v1.0' banner (unlike §4/§6/§7/§8/§9) and specs.md §2 states 'Payload-level FR-FS still tracks §5'. Fabricating frame bytes here would REDEFINE draft wire — forbidden (wire is referenced, never redefined). Each entry states the frozen SEMANTIC obligation and the EXACT freeze it is BLOCKED on. When protocol.md §5 (read + upload halves) freezes, the specs.md §4.4 FR-FS payload mirror lands, and the specs.md jail definition (chokepoint + forbidden set) freezes, firmware-test-author fills in field tuples + zlib-oracle frame_hex and promotes the wire-level entries into corpus.json. This is the S2->S3->S4 pattern: see s3_pending.json / s4_pending.json.

_meta.frozen_inputs: protocol.md §3.1 frame (G0); §4 opcode SET+numbers incl. 0x10 FILE_LIST / 0x11 FILE_STAT / 0x12 FILE_GET_BEGIN / 0x13 FILE_GET_DATA / 0x14 FILE_GET_END / 0x15 FILE_PUT_BEGIN / 0x16 FILE_PUT_DATA / 0x17 FILE_PUT_END / 0x18 FILE_DELETE / 0x19 MKDIR / 0x1A FILE_RENAME / 0x41 FILE_PUT_ACK (G1 2026-07-01, closes OI-4); §8 status SET+numbers incl. OK/EBADREQ/ENOENT/EACCES/ENOSPC/EIO/ENOMEM/EBUSY/ECRC/ERANGE/EUNSUPPORTED/EINTERNAL (G1 2026-07-01); §7 caps fs_root / chunk_size / put_window W=4 / max_file_size (G1). The specs.md FR-FS MUSTs (FR-FS-1..16), SEC-4, IF-FS exist but their PAYLOAD LEVEL 'still tracks §5'.
_meta.draft_blocking_s5: protocol.md §5 File transfer is DRAFT — the READ payload wire (FILE_LIST entry layout, FILE_STAT {size,crc}, FILE_GET_BEGIN/DATA/END field offsets + where the whole-file CRC is carried) AND the UPLOAD payload wire (FILE_PUT_BEGIN {total_size,crc32,path}+resume_offset, FILE_PUT_DATA {offset,bytes}, FILE_PUT_ACK {ack_offset}, FILE_PUT_END {crc32}, the sliding-window/cumulative-ACK/resume protocol, temp-write-then-rename + whole-file-CRC atomicity, single-active-transfer/EBUSY) are not frozen. The current §5 prose ALSO CONTRADICTS the architect freeze_proposal (see _deviations_from_current_prose). Additionally the F-17 jail forbidden SET + canonicalization algorithm are not yet frozen in specs.md text.
_meta.field_endianness: all multi-byte fields little-endian (per §3.1); path fields length-prefixed [plen:u16][path UTF-8], max path 128 B (ERANGE over) — PROPOSED, freezes with §5

_blocked_on.protocol.md_§5_read: FROZEN §5 read half: FILE_LIST 0x10 CMD [plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status:u8](+[more:u8][count:u16] then count x {[etype:u8][esize:u32][nlen:u16][name]}); FILE_STAT 0x11 CMD [plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status:u8](+[size:u32][crc32:u32]); FILE_GET_BEGIN 0x12 CMD [offset:u32][plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status:u8](+[total_size:u32]); FILE_GET_DATA 0x13 EVT id0 [offset:u32][bytes]; FILE_GET_END 0x14 EVT id0 [crc32:u32] whole-file CRC over [0,total_size)
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§5_upload: FROZEN §5 upload half: FILE_PUT_BEGIN 0x15 CMD [total_size:u32][crc32:u32][plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status:u8](+[resume_offset:u32]); FILE_PUT_DATA 0x16 CMD NO-RSP [offset:u32][bytes]; FILE_PUT_ACK 0x41 EVT id0 [ack_offset:u32]=next-expected(highest contiguous written); FILE_PUT_END 0x17 CMD [crc32:u32] -> RSP [status:u8]; the sliding-window (W=4) Go-Back-N cumulative-ACK protocol; temp-write-then-rename + whole-file-CRC-on-END atomicity; single-active-transfer EBUSY
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§5_write_ops: FROZEN §5 write ops: FILE_DELETE 0x18 CMD [plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status] (file remove / empty-dir rmdir / non-empty-dir EACCES / missing ENOENT); MKDIR 0x19 CMD [plen:u16][path] -> RSP [status] (already-dir OK idempotent / over-file EBADREQ / missing-parent ENOENT); FILE_RENAME 0x1A CMD [slen:u16][src][dlen:u16][dst] -> RSP [status] (both jailed / src-missing ENOENT / dst-non-empty-dir EACCES)
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§5_resume: FROZEN §5 resume field: FILE_PUT_BEGIN RSP resume_offset>0 when a verified partial temp prefix exists (S5 always 0; behaviour lands F-10/S6); FILE_STAT {size,crc} of the verified prefix drives it; a transfer is OK only after a whole-file CRC match
_blocked_on.specs.md_FR-FS_payload_mirror: specs.md §4.4 must drop 'Payload-level FR-FS still tracks §5' and mirror/freeze the payload-level FR-FS block (the §5 field layouts + the single-active-transfer/EBUSY-on-queue-full rulings + the .py/data-only ruling) in its own [docs] commit AFTER protocol.md §5 freezes — no F-08/F-09 payload [red] before that pair of commits
_blocked_on.specs.md_jail_freeze: specs.md must FREEZE the F-17 jail definition (firmware-internal, architect-owned): the single chokepoint (pble_fs_resolve) + the concrete forbidden SET — (a) anything not canonicalizing inside fs_root (../ traversal / absolute escape) -> EACCES, (b) the reserved '.pbltmp' transfer-scratch suffix -> EACCES, (c) a reserved agent-prefix set -> EACCES — plus the canonicalization algorithm (reject NUL/empty -> EBADREQ, overlong -> ERANGE). FR-FS-11 is NOT testable as written until this lands (the agent/overlay are firmware-EMBEDDED per ADR-0006, not vfs paths).

_deviations_from_current_prose: TWO deliberate C3-lean DEVIATIONS in the architect freeze_proposal that CONTRADICT the current DRAFT §5 prose — must be called out AT THE §5 FREEZE so the Dart/app team codes to them: (1) FILE_GET_BEGIN RSP DROPS the up-front crc32 (current §5 line ~124 reads 'RSP { status, total_size, crc32 }'); the up-front crc forces a pre-scan double-read of flash, so the whole-file CRC moves to FILE_GET_END; the app may FILE_STAT first if it wants the CRC before streaming. (2) Windowed PUT is GO-BACK-N with NO reorder buffer: the worker writes ONLY at the contiguous watermark; offset==watermark -> write + ACK{new watermark}; offset<watermark -> duplicate, re-ACK{watermark} (idempotent); offset>watermark -> gap, DROP + re-ACK{watermark} (app resends from watermark). One temp file + one watermark counter, no per-chunk heap churn. Until these two land in the frozen §5 text, the corresponding pending vectors below stay unwired.
_frozen_frame_level_already_in_corpus: corpus.json ALREADY carries ONE frame-level (opaque-payload) FS vector whose opcode is §4-frozen: file_put_data_cmd (0x16, 16-byte opaque payload) — it guards the FRAME CODEC + CRC + fragmentation for a FILE_PUT_DATA frame ONLY, NOT the [offset:u32][bytes] payload semantics. When §5 freezes, add frame-level opaque vectors for the remaining FS opcodes (0x10/0x11/0x12/0x13/0x14/0x15/0x17/0x18/0x19/0x1A/0x41) and then the PAYLOAD-SEMANTIC vectors below.
_host_vs_hil: SPLIT: pble_fs is NATIVE C (pble_fs.c, ADR-0006) — there is NO host-importable Python module to unit-test on the CPython host (unlike the S2/S3 pyble_*.py modules). So the S5 host-runnable-NOW slice is ONLY: (a) the shared FRAME-CODEC corpus (corpus.json) still byte-verifying via test_pyble_proto (frame-level, opaque payload); (b) the no-leak clean-room grep. Native-C UNIT coverage (crc32 whole-file oracle, pble_fs_resolve canonicalization + forbidden-set, list/stat/get payload build) is Unity-on-native and arrives with F-20 (native test harness) — until then those obligations are marked 'unit (native Unity F-20)'. ALL round-trip FS behaviour (F-08 read + whole-file CRC + ENOENT; F-09 windowed PUT + cumulative ACK + ECRC-keeps-old-file + delete/mkdir/rename + .py-only; F-17 traversal/absolute/forbidden -> EACCES + user-code-FS-unaffected) is HIL on ESP32-S3 (UART REPL + BLE via bleak). See gates/g1_s5_check.sh.

pending_vectors.name: file_list_rooted_at_fs_root
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_LIST{path} MUST list a workspace directory ROOTED at fs_root, returning RSP[status]; on OK a [more:u8][count:u16] header then count x {[etype:u8(0=file,1=dir)][esize:u32][nlen:u16][name]}; more=1 signals the listing was truncated to the worker TX buffer. Single RSP only — the frozen §4 set has NO LIST_DATA opcode. Missing dir -> ENOENT (FR-FS-1, FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (entry layout once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: file_stat_size_crc_and_enoent
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_STAT{path} MUST return RSP[status]; on OK [size:u32][crc32:u32] of exactly that one path (the crc used later for resume, FR-FS-2/FR-FS-7). A MISSING path MUST return ENOENT (0x02), never a silent zero-size OK (FR-FS-2, FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (payload once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: file_get_whole_file_crc
pending_vectors.obligation: Download MUST stream FILE_GET_BEGIN{offset,path} -> RSP[status](+[total_size:u32]); then FILE_GET_DATA{offset,bytes} EVTs (one per BLE packet); then FILE_GET_END{crc32} EVT carrying the WHOLE-FILE CRC over [0,total_size) — even on a resume download (offset>0 the worker CRCs the skipped prefix too) so the app always gets a whole-file check (FR-FS-3). DEVIATION: the up-front crc32 in FILE_GET_BEGIN RSP is DROPPED vs current §5 prose (see _deviations_from_current_prose) — whole-file CRC is delivered in FILE_GET_END only.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (offsets + whole-file crc placement once frozen) + HIL (byte-exact download + crc match)

pending_vectors.name: file_get_missing_enoent
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_GET_BEGIN on a MISSING path MUST return RSP{ENOENT} synchronously (no DATA/END stream). A GET offset beyond size MUST return ERANGE (FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: fs_errno_to_status_mapping
pending_vectors.obligation: Filesystem errors MUST map to §8 codes rather than failing silently: ENOENT(path/parent missing), EACCES(jail escape / forbidden / non-empty-dir delete/rename-target), ENOSPC(flash full on write), EIO(unclassified vfs read/write/rename error), ENOMEM(worker allocation failure), ERANGE(bad offset/length, overlong path), EBADREQ(malformed payload / mkdir-over-file), EBUSY(fs-worker request queue full OR transfer already in progress), ECRC(FILE_PUT_END whole-file CRC mismatch), EINTERNAL(nlr caught an unmapped exception). (FR-FS-15, FR-PROTO-6).
pending_vectors.note: the errno->status TABLE is native-C unit-testable (pble_fs_errno_to_status) under Unity at F-20; the end-to-end mapping is HIL.
pending_vectors.verify: unit (native Unity F-20) + conformance + HIL

pending_vectors.name: put_windowed_cumulative_ack_gbn
pending_vectors.obligation: Upload MUST accept windowed chunks with a sliding window of up to W=4 unacknowledged chunks (W from HELLO, FR-FS-4) and emit FILE_PUT_ACK{ack_offset} = highest contiguous byte written = next expected offset, so the app advances the window and retransmits gaps (FR-FS-5, NFR-PERF-2). DEVIATION: GO-BACK-N, NO reorder buffer — offset==watermark writes + ACKs the new watermark; offset<watermark is a duplicate, re-ACKs watermark (idempotent); offset>watermark is a gap, DROPS the chunk + re-ACKs watermark (see _deviations_from_current_prose). FILE_PUT_DATA is NO-RSP; only ACK EVTs flow back.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (window + cumulative ACK once frozen) + HIL (lossy-link window advance + gap retransmit)

pending_vectors.name: put_end_whole_file_crc_ok_only
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_PUT_END{crc32} MUST verify the WHOLE-FILE CRC over the temp file and report OK ONLY after a full-file CRC match (FR-FS-6). watermark != total_size -> ERANGE (incomplete; delete temp, keep old file). A DATA-time write error (ENOSPC/EIO) latched during the transfer surfaces HERE. On OK: fsync + close + os.rename(temp,dest) [atomic on LittleFS].
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (END framing once frozen) + HIL (crc verify + atomic rename)

pending_vectors.name: put_crc_mismatch_ecrc_keeps_old_file
pending_vectors.obligation: A whole-file CRC MISMATCH on FILE_PUT_END MUST return ECRC (0x08) and MUST NOT replace the target file — the temp is deleted and the pre-existing dest file is KEPT intact (FR-FS-14). This is the reliability core: a bad transfer never corrupts an existing good file.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (ECRC RSP once frozen) + HIL (old file byte-intact after a deliberately-corrupted upload)

pending_vectors.name: put_temp_write_then_rename_atomic
pending_vectors.obligation: Uploads MUST use temp-write-then-rename (<dest>.pbltmp inside fs_root, jailed) so a file is never corrupted mid-transfer (FR-FS-9); the dest appears only after fsync + a successful whole-file-CRC-gated os.rename. A CRC mismatch or incomplete transfer NEVER replaces the target.
pending_vectors.note: LittleFS os.rename atomicity across a power cut mid-rename is a HIL durability check (route-to storage-engineer feasibility caveat); fsync-before-rename durability is HIL.
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (atomicity + durability) + conformance (temp-suffix jailing)

pending_vectors.name: put_begin_resume_offset_field
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_PUT_BEGIN RSP MUST carry resume_offset:u32 (S5 always 0; F-10/S6 fills it when a verified partial temp prefix exists, FR-FS-7). The FIELD freezes now so the app codes to it; the resume BEHAVIOUR (return >0, resume rather than restart) lands F-10.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (field present once frozen) + HIL (resume behaviour at F-10)

pending_vectors.name: single_active_transfer_ebusy
pending_vectors.obligation: Exactly ONE active transfer (PUT or GET) at a time; a 2nd *_BEGIN while one is active MUST be refused RSP{EBUSY} (0x07). Also: the fs-worker request queue full on a control op -> EBUSY (bounded mailbox depth W+2=6). This ruling MUST land in specs.md too (architect note).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (EBUSY RSP once frozen) + HIL (concurrent-BEGIN refusal)

pending_vectors.name: file_delete_semantics
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_DELETE{path} MUST: remove a file -> OK; rmdir an EMPTY dir -> OK; refuse a NON-EMPTY dir -> EACCES (no recursive delete); missing -> ENOENT (FR-FS-8, FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: mkdir_semantics
pending_vectors.obligation: MKDIR{path} MUST: create a dir -> OK; already-a-dir -> OK (idempotent); path is an existing FILE -> EBADREQ; missing parent -> ENOENT (FR-FS-8, FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: file_rename_semantics
pending_vectors.obligation: FILE_RENAME{src,dst} MUST jail BOTH src and dst; src missing -> ENOENT; dst is a NON-EMPTY dir -> EACCES; else atomic rename -> OK (FR-FS-8, FR-FS-10, FR-FS-15).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (once frozen) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: py_data_only_no_mpy_pyc
pending_vectors.obligation: The workspace bridge MUST be .py/data-only: the agent MUST NOT require, generate, or depend on .mpy/.pyc in the workspace, nor accept them as transfer artifacts; no server-side compilation. The bridge moves arbitrary bytes but never treats .mpy/.pyc as a transfer artifact (PRD §1A.3 rejection 6, FR-FS-12).
pending_vectors.verify: unit (native Unity F-20, no compile path) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: jail_traversal_and_absolute_escape_eacces
pending_vectors.obligation: File ops MUST be confined to fs_root; ANY path that escapes it MUST be rejected with EACCES (0x03): '../' traversal that resolves outside fs_root, an absolute path outside fs_root, and mixed forms that canonicalize outside. Applies to every FS op (LIST/STAT/GET/PUT/DELETE/MKDIR/RENAME both src+dst). The canonicalizer is the SINGLE chokepoint pble_fs_resolve — the ONLY path into the vfs from the bridge (F-17 refactor AC / SEC-4). (FR-FS-10).
pending_vectors.note: pble_fs_resolve canonicalization is native-C unit-testable (traversal/absolute vectors) under Unity at F-20; the end-to-end EACCES is HIL.
pending_vectors.verify: unit (native Unity F-20 canonicalization) + conformance + HIL

pending_vectors.name: jail_forbidden_set_eacces
pending_vectors.obligation: Writing/replacing the agent control plane (Layer 3) or board overlay (Layer 2) via PBLE/1 file commands MUST return EACCES (FR-FS-11, SEC-4). CANONICALIZED forbidden set (architect jail freeze, since agent+overlay are firmware-EMBEDDED per ADR-0006, NOT vfs files): (a) anything not inside fs_root, (b) the reserved '.pbltmp' transfer-scratch suffix, (c) a reserved agent-prefix set. A write to any -> EACCES. NUL/empty path -> EBADREQ; overlong (>128 B) -> ERANGE.
pending_vectors.note: FR-FS-11 is NOT testable as written until the specs.md jail freeze defines the concrete forbidden set (architect owns this [docs] commit).
pending_vectors.verify: unit (native Unity F-20 forbidden-set) + conformance + HIL

pending_vectors.name: jail_user_code_fs_unaffected
pending_vectors.obligation: The jail constrains ONLY the PBLE/1 file bridge; user CODE running on the board MAY touch the filesystem normally at runtime via standard MicroPython os/vfs — it never goes through pble_fs_resolve (FR-FS-16). A user program doing open('/anything','w') or os.listdir('/') is unaffected by the bridge jail.
pending_vectors.note: structural/HIL invariant — a RUN of user code that reads/writes outside a would-be-jailed path succeeds, proving the jail is bridge-only.
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (user code FS access works while bridge is jailed)

pending_vectors.name: jail_single_chokepoint_unbypassable
pending_vectors.obligation: EVERY vfs op MUST route through the SINGLE validation chokepoint pble_fs_resolve first — there is NO second path into the vfs from the bridge; the jail can never be bypassed (SEC-4). This is the F-17 [refactor] acceptance criterion (one chokepoint, structurally enforced).
pending_vectors.note: structural — verified by native-C review + Unity that each handler calls pble_fs_resolve before any mp_vfs_* touch; SEC-4 is control-plane-non-writable.
pending_vectors.verify: unit (native Unity F-20, chokepoint routing) + HIL

pending_vectors.name: fs_identity_never_gates_access
pending_vectors.obligation: The agent MUST NOT gate FS access on MAC / device_id / label; FILE_* ops MUST behave IDENTICALLY whether or not a label is configured. Test identity is DISPLAY-ONLY (SEC-11). This is a structural/HIL invariant, not a byte vector — the gate re-asserts it every slice.
pending_vectors.verify: unit (structure) + HIL
